saved_top3_and_first_positive.text: The invention relates to a polymer PVC decoration product and a manufacturing method. A traditional marble-imitated plate has the defects that a coarse whiting surface treatment process is complex, manufacturing cost is high, and PVC resin, coarse whiting and other inorganic powder suffer from buckling deformation when heated and cooled in the processing and production process. The polymer PVC decoration product is composed of a base material A (1) and a base material B (5), the upper plane of the base material A and the upper plane of the base material B are connected with a surface layer (2) in a hot extrusion or hot forming mode, and the surface layer comprises an outer surface weather-proof layer (6). The outer surface weather-proof layer (6) is attached to a color figure or marbling film (7), the color figure or marbling film is attached to a thermoplastic elastomer layer (8), the thermoplastic elastomer layer (8) is attached tothe base material A and the base material B, dovetail-shaped grooves (3) are formed in the two ends of the base material A, and dovetail-shaped protrusions (4) are arranged at the two ends of the base material B.

saved_top3_and_first_positive.text: The present disclosure is related to a construction material to make a product such as furniture for interiors and exteriors, used in the manufacturing process of different domestic and industrial articles according to the needs of the user and the resistance capacity of the material of the invention, emulating a natural wood or marble table. Chemical formula for mixing plastic polymers from a recycling process to form an imitation marble plate, which comprises a formula and a process for obtaining a plate that emulates the texture of marble. The formula comprises the following compounds: polystyrene, which is about 25% of the total thickness of the plate with a standard deviation of +/- 10%; a mixture comprising 50% of pelleted rubber with a standard deviation of +/- 15% and 50% of polystyrene with a standard deviation of +/- 15%; mixed with between 1.8 to 4.8 liters of liquid silicone. And that the mixture of these three elements (which are only the second layer) correspond to a 50% of the total thickness with a standard deviation of +/- 15%; Polystyrene corresponding to 25% of the total thickness with a standard deviation of +/- 10%. The process includes the following steps: a).- Draining in layers: The first draining is polystyrene and corresponds to the outer face, characterized in that it is about 25% of the total thickness with a standard deviation of +/- 10% of the plate; b).- The second draining is characterized by being 50% of the total thickness with a standard deviation of +/- 15% and comprises a mixture of 50% of pelleted rubber with a standard deviation of +/- 15% and 50% polystyrene with a standard deviation of +/- 15%; these elements are mixed with 1.8 to 4.8 liters of liquid silicone previously of being added to the second draining, creating a second layer which is characterized by having 50% of the total thickness of the plate with a standard deviation of +/- 15%; c).- A third layer which is also characterized by containing 15 to 35% of the total thickness of the polystyrene.
